title: Senior Data Architect / Senior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks
description:
Remote, occasionally Zurich · 80–100% · Start as soon as possible · 

Xebia pushes the boundaries of what’s possible – and you’re right in the middle of it! We’re not just consultants, but visionaries: with more than 5,000 experts worldwide, we help our clients drive their digital transformation with passion and ambition. At Xebia, it’s about more than recommendations: with innovative solutions, we create a unique combination of technology, people and processes. Our goal is to make our clients digital frontrunners – ready to turn media usage data into insights that make a difference?

About the project
Our client, a large Swiss media company, is building a new platform on Azure Databricks for the usage data of its apps and websites. It will replace the commercial analytics tool they use today. Analysts are starting to work on the new platform now.

Your role
You join the platform team of five developers through Xebia. Most of your time goes into implementing Jira tickets. You build and run the pipelines that take event data from Azure Event Hubs through the bronze, silver and gold layers into the tables analysts and dashboards use. You keep the Databricks and Azure infrastructure in code with Pulumi and ship changes through GitHub Actions. The team creates and refines tickets together and reviews each other's code. You'll also help analysts get started with Databricks and GitHub.

As the senior person in the team, you can advise on anything from implementation details to the overall architecture, while the product owner sets the priorities. Today the role also covers the data model, the infrastructure and the platform costs, and there is room to take on more responsibility over time. The team uses AI coding assistants such as Claude in its daily work.

title: Data Engineer: Merchant Intelligence Agent
description:
About Us
 Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.
 About the Team
 We build the AI agent that helps merchandisers, product managers, and executives grow their e-commerce business: it finds opportunities in their data, tailors insights to each person's role, and takes routine work off their plate by delivering answers where they already work. We are transforming how digital merchandising teams work: instead of digging through reports and configuring rules by hand, they ask in plain language, get answers grounded in their own data, and approve the changes the agent prepares. Customers already rely on the agent to save time and make better decisions.
 We own the agent end to end, from the first question a merchant asks to the answer they act on. We also own the analytics behind it: the pipelines and cubes for search, browse, and recommendation performance, and the metric definitions merchants rely on.
 That is why we build the agent and the Customer Dashboard as a platform that every Constructor team extends. We create the foundation that other teams build on: the agent framework, shared components, and infrastructure. On top of it, teams add their own data, tools, and skills, so the agent can answer questions in their domain and the dashboard can show their features without separate interfaces. Each new capability gives merchants more ways to grow their business.
 What you'll do
 Build and own the batch pipelines and cubes behind dashboard analytics and agent insights
 Model shopper, trend, and benchmark data so the agent can find opportunities across the shopping journey
 Shape data for each role: a merchandiser's category, a product manager's funnel step, an executive's total
 Own data quality and trust: freshness, monitoring, alerting, and metric definitions

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the role
 At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog . It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.
 Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt , Airflow , S3 , AWS , Superset , and GitHub Actions .  Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.
 Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.
 Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.
 Team contributions
 Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.
 Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.
 Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.
 Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.
 Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

description:

title: Data Engineer (Databricks, Snowflake)
description:
For one of our clients, we are looking for an Advanced Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines and data products. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs and turn diverse data sources into reliable, reusable datasets.
 Design, develop, test and monitor distributed data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads.
 Integrate structured and unstructured data and produce reproducible datasets that meet the needs of data consumers.
 Advise clients on technical options and explain design decisions to technical and business stakeholders.
 Work with architects, software engineers and data scientists to deliver data products iteratively.
 Degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a comparable qualification.
 At least three years of experience in data engineering or software engineering.
 Practical Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases.
 Experience building and maintaining data products, with knowledge of architectures such as data lakes, lakehouses and medallion architectures.
 Experience with cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or Amazon SageMaker.
 Familiarity with large-scale data processing, data analysis and visualisation, as well as agile development and DevOps.
 Hands-on experience with or interest in technologies such as Spark, Delta Lake, Airflow, Kafka, Kubernetes or Terraform.

We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non-corporate.  AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance.
